config.name: feature_value_against_cached_qwen_development
config.reference_note: Qwen support-adapted development-fold scores, not hidden Kaggle outputs
restrictions: No blends, thresholds or slice tuning
Original train labels only for retrospective scoring
No private content in public export

cohorts.policy: No Advertising: Spam, referral links, unsolicited advertising, and promotional content are not allowed.
No legal advice: Do not offer or request legal advice.

limitations: Cached Qwen scores are from development folds, not hidden Kaggle predictions.
The 881 comments have been repeatedly inspected; this is not fresh validation.
Conditional intervals cover seven contrasts, not all historical selection.
Pairs share comments; pair counts are not independent sample sizes.
Slices are fixed, overlapping, approximate text flags; not causal mechanisms.
Ranking complementarity does not guarantee useful feature additions or blends.
No threshold, calibrator, ensemble weight, or feature is fitted in this audit.
Source/data hashes and exact historical row order are required before scoring.
